- The Recommender said they had never seen *Double Jeopardy*.
- I said I also like *Gone Girl* (2014).
- The Recommender asked if I had seen *The Zodiac* (2005).
- I said yes, I really like that movie, and that I like murder mysteries.
- The Recommender said they also like murder mysteries and recommended *Rear Window* (1954), calling it “an oldie but goodie.”
